ukmt-grey-2022-03.prompt: The front number plate of Max's car fell off. He put it back upside down but luckily this didn't make any difference. Which of the following could be Max's number plate?

ukmt-grey-2022-17.prompt: You can choose four positive integers $X$, $Y$, $Z$ and $W$. What is the maximum number of odd numbers you can obtain from the six sums $X+Y$, $X+Z$, $X+W$, $Y+Z$, $Y+W$ and $Z+W$?

ukmt-grey-2022-20.prompt: Carl wrote a list of 10 distinct positive integers on a board. Each integer in the list, apart from the first, is a multiple of the previous integer. The last of the 10 integers is between 600 and 1000. What is this last integer?
